dedupe_keys.name: hiron pl high speed road network of poland with commissioning dates 1936 2023

description: HiRoN-PL documents the development of Poland's high-speed road network (motorways and expressways) from 1936 to 2023. Road geometry is extracted from OpenStreetMap motorway, motorway link and selected trunk ways and processed for topological continuity at junctions and alignment with commissioning phases. Each section carries its commissioning year, month and day, road name, end node names, class (motorway or expressway), original OSM and authority identifiers, OSM highway tag and length; the dates come from official and public registers, including those of the General Directorate for National Roads and Motorways (GDDKiA), completed where needed with verified crowdsourced information. It was produced by Przemysław Śleszyński and Katarzyna Krasnodębska (version 1.1, April 2026, after version 1.0 in February 2026). Coverage is national (Poland). The data are free under CC BY 4.0 and available to download from Zenodo as a GeoPackage in the Polish CS92 reference system. Caveats: it covers only the high-speed network, and dates rely partly on crowdsourced information. It supports historical network growth analysis, accessibility change and the age of road assets for condition models. It complements the TEN-T network data and is related to the Australian national roads dataset.
